audience: payroll and HR teams that track working hours and absences in MiJornada

useCases.title: Check worked hours for a pay period
useCases.text: List the worked and break minutes for each person and day. These are the figures in force, so use them for payroll.

useCases.title: Find long weeks and missing clock-outs
useCases.text: List the workdays of a week and find people who worked more than 40 hours. Open the raw clock events of a day to see a missing clock-out.

useCases.title: Review absences for a team
useCases.text: List the vacations and other absences that overlap a month. Check the dates, days and state of each one.

useCases.title: Total project hours for a client
useCases.text: Find the client and its projects. Then list the minutes logged per person, day and project for the period.

useCases.title: Read statements to invoice
useCases.text: List the statements to invoice that were issued in a date range, with their lines and VAT. They are not invoices and have no tax validity.
